    Object-indexed coordinates for represented string-arrow maps #

    Keeping the biproduct coordinates indexed by the objects of the quotient path category avoids transporting a large dependent product along the equivalence with the displayed quiver vertices. Yoneda evaluation is performed directly in each object coordinate.

    source

    P.representedVertexCoordinateFamily x X ≃ₗ[k] CoveringHom.linearCoyonedaLinearModule X ⟶ (P.quotientRepresentable (obj P.relations x)).obj

    Forgetting the finite-dimensional-module subtype identifies a morphism between represented modules with the corresponding natural transformation.
